ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

text.en: PMMY, launched on 8 April 2015, gives micro enterprises access to collateral-free institutional credit.

description.quote: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) was launched on 08.04.2015 with the objective of providing access to institutional collateral free credit to micro enterprises.

text.en: Loan categories: Shishu up to ₹50,000; Kishore above ₹50,000 up to ₹5 lakh; Tarun above ₹5 lakh up to ₹10 lakh.

benefits.quote: Categories: Shishu – upto Rs.50,000; Kishore– Above Rs.50,000 and upto Rs.5 lakh; Tarun- Above Rs.5 lakh and upto Rs.10 lakh;

text.en: Collateral is not required; loans are given by banks, regional rural banks, small finance banks, NBFCs and MFIs.

benefits.quote: Member Lending Institutions (MLIs): Public Sector Banks (PSBs), Private Sector Banks, Foreign Banks, Regional Rural Banks, Small Finance Banks, Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs), Micro Finance Institutions (MFIs) and NBFC- MFIs; Collateral not required.

text.en: For non-agricultural micro enterprises, including activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy and beekeeping; term loans and working capital.

statement.quote: Purposes: Non-agricultural, including activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy, beekeeping etc. Term loan and working capital requirements can both be met;

label.en: A Member Lending Institution (bank, RRB, small finance bank, NBFC or MFI)
